name: instapot rice
instructions:
Instapot method for plain rice. Small technique note, not a full recipe.

1. Add rice and water to the instapot. USE LESS WATER than you'd use on the stove — less than the knuckle rule. See notes.
2. Seal. Cook on HIGH pressure for 3 minutes.
3. Natural pressure release for 5-10 minutes.
4. Fluff and serve.
notes:
=== LESS WATER THAN THE STOVE (LESS THAN THE KNUCKLE RULE) ===

Instapot rice needs LESS water than stovetop rice. The stovetop knuckle rule (water covers the rice up to your first knuckle when your fingertip touches the top of the rice) is TOO MUCH for the instapot — sealed pressure cooking doesn't lose water to evaporation the way an open pot does, so the same water ratio ends up as too-wet rice.

Start with the water level clearly BELOW your first knuckle and adjust from there based on the rice variety and how the first batch comes out.

=== 3 MINUTES HIGH + 5-10 MIN NATURAL RELEASE ===

HIGH pressure, 3 minutes cook time, then NATURAL pressure release for 5-10 min (don't quick-release). The natural release is where the rice actually finishes cooking — pulling the pressure off too fast leaves the interior underdone. Wait it out.
